work.title: C01 — Outcome ledger for official CLI agent runs
work.description: Record each task run of the unmodified official CLIs (claude -p / codex exec wrappers; later Paperclip agent.run.completed events) into a local SQLite ledger: task category (from a declared task template or label), provider, model, reasoning effort, start/end, exit status, declared verify-command result (tests), review/retry count, usage-limit event and parsed reset time, estimated cost/quota units. Two real workloads: this Foundry repository and /home/jonathan/kaggle/arc3. No credential handling; no change to how work is requested.
work.acceptance_criteria: At least 50 real task runs recorded across the two repositories within two weeks with ≥90% of runs carrying a verifiable outcome field; ledger schema documented; `fleet report` summarises runs by task category × model × effort; unit tests for wrappers and parser on captured fixtures. Stop rule: fewer than 50 real runs in two weeks means the pain is too rare on these workloads — record that and hold.
